title: Advanced Types
description: Learn advanced TypeScript types including generics, utility types, and type guards.
longDescription: This module elevates your TypeScript skills with advanced type features. You'll master generics for reusable components, utility types for transforming existing types, and type guards for runtime type narrowing. These patterns are essential for building scalable, type-safe React applications and will be used throughout the rest of the course.
whatYouLearn: Use discriminated unions for safer code
